name: MatMul
description: Computes the matrix product `A * B` with ONNX `MatMul` semantics, including vector promotion and NumPy-style broadcasting over batch dimensions. This package currently supports float16, float32, int32, and uint32 tensors. All legal rank-1 through rank-4 combinations are implemented; rank-5 is supported only when both inputs have rank 5, so legal mixed-rank combinations between a rank-5 operand and a rank-1 through rank-4 operand are not yet implemented. Higher-rank inputs and other ONNX-supported types are also not yet implemented.

outputs.rank: max(ranks.A, ranks.B) - (1 if ranks.A == 1 or ranks.B == 1 else 0)
outputs.description: Matrix multiply result of `A * B`, including vector promotion and broadcast batch dimensions.

tunableDescriptions.SUBGROUP_MATRIX_MIN_M: Sets the minimum output-row count admitted to rank-two and folded-row subgroup-matrix variants.
tunableDescriptions.SUBGROUP_MATRIX_BATCH_MIN_M: Sets the minimum per-matrix output-row count admitted to batched subgroup-matrix variants.
tunableDescriptions.TILED_REG_MIN_WORKGROUPS: Sets the minimum output-tile workgroup count admitted to the smaller register-blocked batched routes.
tunableDescriptions.TILED_REG_LARGE_MIN_WORKGROUPS: Sets the minimum output-tile workgroup count admitted to the large register-blocked rank-two and batched routes.
tunableDescriptions.GEMV_PARALLEL_MIN_M: Sets the minimum output-row count admitted to tail-safe parallel matrix-vector variants.
tunableDescriptions.GEMV_PARALLEL_MIN_K: Sets the minimum reduction width admitted to tail-safe parallel matrix-vector variants.
tunableDescriptions.DOT_SPLIT_MIN_K: Sets the minimum vector length admitted to the split dot-product route.
tunableDescriptions.DOT_MAX_SPLITS: Caps the number of dot-product partials, bounding scratch and combine work.

variants.description: Partitions the K reduction across workgroups while retaining subgroup-matrix tiles, then combines float32 partials. It serves output grids with too few unsplit tiles to occupy the device, and the combine reassociates the reduction.
Folded-rows twin of `subgroup_matrix_splitk`: a rank-3 A with a unit row axis is a contiguous `[M, K]` view, so the same K-partitioned subgroup-matrix tiles and float32 combine apply unchanged.

when: ceilDiv(dim(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 2), registerTile) * ceilDiv(dim(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 1), registerTile) * outer(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 2) >= tunables.TILED_REG_MIN_WORKGROUPS
ceilDiv(dim(shapes.Y, 2), registerTile) * ceilDiv(dim(shapes.Y, 3), registerTile) * dim(shapes.Y, 0) * dim(shapes.Y, 1) >= tunables.TILED_REG_MIN_WORKGROUPS

ceilDiv(dim(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 2), registerTile) * ceilDiv(dim(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 1), registerTile) * (numel(shapes.Y) / dim(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 2) / dim(shapes.Y, ranks.Y - 1)) >= tunables.TILED_REG_LARGE_MIN_WORKGROUPS

variants.description: Assigns one output row to each workgroup and uses scalar loads for a reduction width that is not vec4-aligned, then folds the row with a fixed-width subgroup. It is the parallel large-matrix-vector route when that subgroup geometry is available.
Uses the same tail-safe, one-workgroup-per-row traversal but folds partials through workgroup memory. It applies when fixed-width subgroup geometry is unavailable.

Partitions a long vector dot product across workgroups and combines float32 partials to expose parallelism beyond one workgroup. The combine reassociates the sum, so this route is not bit-identical to the single-workgroup dot route.
